envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: live assay: on Claude Code the stance and purview guards fire and exit at their scope gate on every call, because the claude projection deploys no stance scope and the payload's agent_type is not read; nothing warns

payload.gloss: the agents an enforcing cell binds, fixed by composition: a guard fires for exactly the agents whose composition includes it, on every supported harness. Each harness carries the scope in the form it offers (omp: a stance manifest per persona; Claude Code: the agent_type its hook payload names), and a harness that cannot name the running agent degrades the guard to a steer and warns at projection and install. A guard that fires but can never judge is neither bound nor warned, and is the defect this concept rules out.
